summary: Verified Home 'Every way to visit' tile label legibility fix. All 6 explore tiles (menu, buffet, banqueting/Private Dining, catering, offers, membership) render with the required text-shadow (rgba(0,0,0,0.65) 0px 2px 12px) and contain a bottom linear-gradient overlay div using rgba(30,17,12,...). Both desktop (1920x900) and mobile (420x900) screenshots confirm labels are clearly legible over the underlying images. Regression navigation still works: clicking 'The Menu' -> /menu and 'Buffet' -> /buffet succeed. Unique per-tile images retained (no regression from iteration_2).
critical_code_review_comments: Home.jsx tiles rendering block is fine; consider extracting the tile component (~15 lines JSX per tile config) into a small subcomponent if the file grows further — currently 159 lines, acceptable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Home explore tiles fix is verified. If iterating further on Home, keep the per-tile bottom gradient (rgba(30,17,12,...)) and title text-shadow — removing them will regress label legibility over bright images (curry, cocktail, etc.). data-testids: explore-tile-{menu|buffet|banqueting|catering|offers|membership}, section data-testid='home-explore'.
